upstream.install_source: conda-forge scanpy ==1.12.3 with the committed inst/pixi/scrublet/pixi.lock

assays_layers: raw counts layer (default 'counts'); normalized layers are rejected
storage_backends: in-memory sparse matrices exported to MatrixMarket; BPCells layers are materialized once
requirements: at least ten cells reach the retained set
cells with zero totals or below min_features are skipped upstream of scoring

scenarios: ignored by scrublet; BPCells chunking is scDblFinder-specific

parameters.upstream: sc.pp.scrublet kwargs (seed -> random_state, n_prin_comps, n_neighbors, expected_doublet_rate, stdev_doublet_rate, synthetic_doublet_umi_subsampling)

wrapper: manifest captured in the run log
waivers: cluster/grouped BPCells chunking is scDblFinder-specific and out of scope for this subject

equivalence.ordering: joined on cell barcode over the shared retained set
equivalence.reason: Candidate runner forwards the same seed to sc.pp.scrublet as the oracle; scores are deterministic given matched inputs.

execution.rng_kind: scanpy scrublet random_state seeded from backend_control$seed
execution.acceleration: not applicable (Python backend); R-side ShennongOpt scopes do not wrap scrublet

fixtures.source: pbmc3k ground-truth object /mnt/resources/pbmc/pbmc3k/analysis/pbmc3k.rds, random sample generated by scripts/make-scrublet-fixtures.R (seed 2401)
fixtures.license: 10x Genomics PBMC 3k demo data, research use

fixtures.source: pbmc3k ground-truth object /mnt/resources/pbmc/pbmc3k/analysis/pbmc3k.rds, random sample generated by scripts/make-scrublet-fixtures.R (seed 717)
fixtures.license: 10x Genomics PBMC 3k demo data, research use
fixtures.role: C2 oracle/candidate parity on real data

expected: non-count layers fail fast with a raw-counts error
scDblFinder-only arguments emit a warning under method='scrublet'
conditions.outside_envelope: missing pixi environment fails with an installation hint before analysis

evidence.limitations: Doublet detection is not yet a registered inst/methods task, so this subject stays pilot until doublet methods enter the registry with an admitted key; reduced scenario coverage (single seed, one fixture tier pair) matches the pilot profile.
